task_name: World 472 Task B  -  Un-Invoiced Won Proposal 50% Consumer Financing Draw & Round-Loan Dealer-Fee Hold
prompt: Evaluate the remaining unmatched third-party consumer financing wires in `desert_crest_bank_feed_and_crm_nov2026.xlsx` against the open Accounts Receivable and un-invoiced signed Won Proposals schedules. Reconstruct the implied progress-draw percentage or round-loan dealer-fee schedules, determine which un-invoiced CRM job corresponds to the custodial financing draw, and state the required operational and GAAP controls to prevent duplicate revenue recognition.

rubric.description: Holds the 2 third-party financing wires totaling $26,430.00 ($17,500.00 BF-1104B GreenSky Custodial + $8,930.00 BF-1106C Service Finance) out of the $67,435.36 total pending bank-feed deposits.

Identifies BF-1104B ($17,500.00) as a 49.99% (~50% Stage 1 progress draw, $3.14 rounding delta vs. $17,503.14) against T. Denham's un-invoiced signed Won Proposal on JOB-11870848 ($35,006.28, 0 CRM invoices).
Computes the exact round-loan dealer-fee hypotheses on BF-1106C ($8,930.00): 6.00% fee ($570.00) on a $9,500.00 gross loan or 5.00% fee ($470.00) on a $9,400.00 gross loan.

Explains that operations must generate the official CRM invoice on JOB-11870848 before matching (never fabricating an un-numbered QBO invoice or booking directly to Sales, which would duplicate $35,006.28 when nightly CRM sync imports the invoice).
